snippet.title: Oops, I Broke a Cup! ☕ Always Tell the Truth | Islam for Kids #shorts
snippet.description:
Oops! You broke a cup and nobody was looking. What do you do?

Our Prophet Muhammad-e-Mustafa (Sallallahu Ta'ala Alaihi Wa Aalihi Wasallam) said: "Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise." (narrated by Abdullah bin Mas'ud Radi Allahu Anhu)

Telling the truth can feel hard, but Allah loves people who tell the truth, and people trust you more and more. So always tell the truth, even when it is hard! Will your little one say: Yes, I will?

Source
• Sahih al-Bukhari 6094: https://sunnah.com/bukhari:6094

Masjid-e-Nabawi footage: DesignwithRiyas on Pixabay (https://pixabay.com/videos/id-112360/)

We never show any Prophet or Companion. All characters are faceless.
For ages 3 to 9 · Ahl-e-Sunnat wal Jama'at

#IslamForKids #MuslimKids #Honesty #TellTheTruth #shorts
